headline: A 1-for-5 night
record_line: Yesterday: 1-4 on the top plays · Season: 1-4

entries.headline: Kerry Carpenter stayed in the yard
entries.story: Kerry Carpenter went 1-for-4 against Randy Dobnak and the Kansas City Royals. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Spencer Torkelson stayed in the yard
entries.story: Spencer Torkelson went 0-for-4 against Randy Dobnak and the Kansas City Royals. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 3 times.

entries.headline: George Springer came close
entries.story: George Springer went 2-for-3 with 1 BB and 1 RBI against Casey Legumina and the Tampa Bay Rays. Closest call was a double in the 6th: "George Springer doubles (13) on a line drive to left fielder Chandler Simpson." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Salvador Perez stayed in the yard
entries.story: Salvador Perez went 0-for-4 with 1 BB against Troy Melton and the Detroit Tigers. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Drake Baldwin connected at +360
entries.story: Drake Baldwin cashed. Facing Kyle Hart, he went deep in the 7th in his 4th at bat. The call: "Drake Baldwin homers (19) on a fly ball to right field." Final line: 1-for-4.
